results.name: NADPH regeneration

definition.text: A metabolic process that replenishes the cellular or compartmental pool of NADPH by transfer of reducing equivalents from a donor substrate to NADP+, independent of the route or compartment involved.

results.comment: Covers all routes that regenerate NADPH, including the oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway (consider GO:0009051 for annotation), NADP(+)-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase and malic enzyme reactions, folate-mediated one-carbon metabolism, and nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase, in any subcellular compartment.

synonyms.name: reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate regeneration
